title: Sorting records
hints: Compare people by Age first. Only when the ages are equal does the name decide.
cmp.Or(cmp.Compare(a.Age, b.Age), strings.Compare(a.Name, b.Name)) returns the age comparison unless it is 0, in which case it returns the name comparison.
slices.SortFunc(people, func(a, b Person) int { return cmp.Or(cmp.Compare(a.Age, b.Age), strings.Compare(a.Name, b.Name)) })
